newsitem.title: USA: Holly settles litigation with trust.
newsitem.headline: Holly settles litigation with trust.

text.p: Holly Products Inc said it settled litigation with the Calvin Black Trust in U.S. District Court in Utah.
The Trust and the company reached final settlement on a promissory note of $500,000 by the company, delivering shares of stock in RoomSystems Inc in lieu of payment.

"We are very happy with this settlement and look forward to completing our last piece of litigation in regard to the Country World Casinos Chapter 11 Proceedings in short order. With these last issues behind us, we can concentrate on the business at hand," said William H. Patrowicz, president of Holly Products Inc, in a statement.
The company did not provide further information and did not return repeated calls to its office.
Country World Casinos Inc, majority owned by Holly, is a development corporation, which plans to construct a casino in Black Hawk, Colo., as well as a hotel complex.
